watch.en: Skim off the fat and impurities that rise to the surface.
watch.de: Fett und Trübstoffe abschöpfen, die an die Oberfläche steigen.

why.en: Left in, they may make the liquid cloudy.
why.de: Bleiben sie darin, kann die Flüssigkeit trüb werden.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.1 Light Stocks, section Skim the Stock Frequently
sources.sentence: A stock should be skimmed often to remove the fat and impurities that rise to the surface during cooking.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.1 Light Stocks, section Skim the Stock Frequently
sources.sentence: If they are not removed, they may make the stock cloudy.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Sauces, The Importance of a Cold Start and Uncovered, Slow Heating, p. 600
sources.sentence: It also dehydrates the surface scum, which becomes more insoluble and easier to skim.

sources.title: Der junge Koch / Die junge Köchin (Brandes, Harten, Krödel, Voll, Wolffgang), 38th edition, Pfanneberg 2022
sources.place: Suppen und Saucen - Brühen, Pflege der entstehenden Flüssigkeiten - Abschäumen (Ecumieren), p. 591
sources.sentence: In diesem Schaum befinden sich auch die in der Flüssigkeit vorhandenen und nun gebundenen Trübstoffe.
